author: Claude Opus 5.5 implementation sub-agent (early range M1-M5); no subagents
scope: Source-only world refinements for AC04 Normal missions 1-5 (Sitting Duck, Imminent Threat, The Northern Eye, Blockade, Lifeline). Native WorldPlan terrain ops and primitive parts only; no Blender/imported/uploaded/skin assets. NOT wired, NOT built, NOT run in Roblox Studio or Player, NOT merged, NOT live.

honestStatus.releaseConvention: Owner convention (AGENTS.md, current): gameplay PRs merged to main are LIVE in Roblox Player via automatic CI/CD; no upload-receipt check or Player test is required to update availability. This Early work is UNMERGED, UNWIRED local source, so it is not live and changes no published availability. Last known place version 63 (commit efc7120, PR #90, accepted 2026-10-27T23:18:57Z, CI run 40601149377) is historical supporting metadata only; no newer version is claimed. Release status is separate from fidelity/quality acceptance: none of M1-M5's new worlds has native, Studio or Player observation.

frozenArtifact.note: The independently verified M1-M5 completions belong to this frozen candidate, which does not contain these modules. Those completions are NOT evidence for the rebuilt worlds.

honestStatus.claimLimits: No mission here is complete, beta-ready or source-exact. Mitoro diagrams are Ace difficulty and show target symbols and routes, not terrain; counts were never taken from them. All relief, coastlines and scale are adaptations.

missions.title: Sitting Duck
changed: Reset old coarse hills/runway/settlement; built Newfield Island as 100-stud rotated slices along a SW-NE axis (sand shelf + grass) from a 16-point half-width profile.
Mountain spine (5 tapered ridges, rock crests, peak ~544 studs) NW of the axis plus two spurs.
Anderson Crater: 10-segment rock rim, flooded bowl, SSW breach to the sea with a small islet.
Allenfort Air Base on the NE tip: cleared corridor, runway along the island axis, taxiway, apron, 3 hangars, tower, radome.
Belta Port: levelled SE slope with 11 city blocks, breakwaters, pier and harbour light.
Crater-shoulder impact ruins (non-solid); Fort Grays carrier silhouette south of the island (non-solid decoration).
Layout sites airbase/settlement moved onto the island (world-only sites; no unit uses them).
missions.unchanged: All bombers/escorts positions, spawn (0,950,2600), returnZ, 600 s phase, score.
sourceSupported: Island name, mountainous shape, Allenfort on the north tip, Belta Port, crater on the eastern face (wiki/lparchive)
Island SW-NE elongation, spine, crater breach and islet (Namco concept art)

N-S runway threaded between the centre-left and right-row clusters; no scored unit sits on it (base had AA/hangars under the runway).
Dispersal aprons, taxiways, earth revetments, perimeter road, substation yard with transformer bays and a 5-pylon power line to the base.
Patchwork farmland top-layer repaint, low northern hills beyond Ciffreo's station, frontline farm village.

Which facility dots are hangars vs tower

missions.title: The Northern Eye

Mt. Shezna summits: crossed tapered rock massifs with snow caps, summit ridge and levelled snow bench under each chain; saddle ridge and northern snow range; grass foothills.
Barracks, relay masts, CH-47 helipad on the west summit (decoration).
M3 air spawns within 1,150 studs of a summit lifted to summit+200 (CH-47, F-16, F-16 reinforcements): the base world already embedded them inside the west summit (y 850 at an 850 crest).
missions.unchanged: Counts, 900+900 s phases, extract-south return, spawn, returnZ, intercept fighters.
sourceSupported: Radars on Mt. Shezna peaks, east/west bases, southern Return Line (wiki)
Chain shapes/orientation and east-then-west route (Mitoro d1/d2)
interpolation: Chain spacing widened from Mitoro's ~45 studs to >=130
missions.risk: MEDIUM: summit relief is now real (north range >500 studs above the base land), radar/AA positions changed and three air spawns are 100-200 studs higher. Southern return corridor verified flat (z >= 0). Needs M3 replay including the return leg.

missions.title: Blockade

Rolling inland downs, two wind farms (19 turbines: tapered tower, nacelle, hub, non-solid 4-arm rotor facing the sea), coastal highway, headland lighthouse, farms.

Transports heading NE, two jamming circles (Mitoro)

Four-arm rotors (yaw-only parts cannot tilt three blades)

missions.title: Lifeline
changed: Replaced the rectangular land slab with an irregular coastline (refinery coast, sea east).
Removed the solid 1,500x1,800 refinery apron that sat 2 studs above all 39 refinery target bases (pure audit); replaced with a non-solid apron plus bund walls outside the pads.
Process unit (5 distillation columns with access rings, heaters, pipe rack), export pipe rack to a tanker jetty with loading head, arms and mooring dolphins, shore flare stack.

Offshore field: one jacketed main deck exactly under the production 5x9 rig grid (top 110 = rigs site y), cellar deck, 20 jacket legs, railings, helideck, flare boom; four bridge-linked satellite wellhead platforms (incl. Mitoro's NE outlier sector).
missions.unchanged: EXACT production placement of every M5 unit (121/121 identical), all sites incl. rigs relocation point, spawn, returnZ 3400, 600+240 s phases, afterKills/clearance staging, Yellow rules.
sourceSupported: Coastal refinery west, offshore field east (wiki, Mitoro d1/d2)
Outlying rig clusters incl. north-east (Mitoro d1)
interpolation: Coast shape, process-unit/jetty/flare layout, satellite platforms, helideck

Rig deck shrank from 660x1650 to 560x900 (still under every rig target). Needs an M5 replay to confirm the validated timing still holds.

decisions.chosen: Concept-art Newfield silhouette scaled to the bomber route
alternatives: Open ocean only (Mitoro draws no land)

decisions.chosen: Mitoro close-up four-cluster dispersal at 4.5/7.5 studs/px
decisions.why: Close-up count matches Normal 11; dual scale keeps >=135-stud spacing for 2.1x models.

decisions.chosen: Move to the southern approach (Mitoro d1)
decisions.why: Mitoro marks it far south and attacks it first from range.

decisions.chosen: Crossed tapered native wedge massifs + snow bench, axis-aligned flanks
decisions.why: Keeps every region under the unsplit cap with stepped (<=1/3 height) ends.

decisions.chosen: Lift spawns near summits to summit+200, x/z unchanged
decisions.why: Preserves summit altitude and position while removing spawn-in-terrain.

decisions.chosen: Plausible coast + wind farms only, no ground objectives
decisions.why: Brief forbids manufactured objectives; Comberth geometry here would overclaim. Clearly labelled interpolation.

decisions.chosen: Keep one continuous deck exactly under the production grid; add jackets, helideck, flare boom, satellites
alternatives: Split into three decks with 20-stud gaps
Move rig targets onto separate platforms
decisions.why: Preserves validated placement/timing; 20-stud gaps add risk without visible gain.

decisions.chosen: No decorative part reuses a scored type name or shape class (no decorative fuel tanks, cranes, radars, hulls)
decisions.why: Avoids fake targets; tested for M5.
